:::{#exr-se-error-sd}
#### Spread of the estimation error

Show that the [standard deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-sd)
of the [estimation error](#def-estimation-error) $\erf{\hth}$
equals the [standard error](#def-SE) of $\hth$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-se-error-sd}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Var{\erf{\hth}}
&= \Var{\hth - \th}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \Var{\hth}
&& \text{(subtracting a constant does not change a variance)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Taking square roots of both sides,
$\SD{\erf{\hth}} = \SD{\hth} = \SE{\hth}$.

:::
